messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate in EU blue environment — ~15% of requests returning 502s. Pager: @jamie on-call (primary). Link: https://redwood/incident/3765432100
jamie: On it. digging into metrics now. paging local infra team. :rotating_light:
sara: I see increased 502s from edge-1 and edge-3 in eu-west. Requests are being routed to blue at ~25% of traffic despite target set to 10%.
leo: Confirming — weight table shows eu-west: blue=0.25 green=0.75. I didn't touch it. Propagation TTL still 600s.
maria: Could be a control-plane lag or DNS drift. Logs show recent deploy to blue with new feature flag 'fast-embed' enabled.
kenji: Reproduced locally: blue returns `{"error":"model load timeout"}` for long prompts. Green is fine.
jamie: Ok kill-switch 'fast-embed' -> OFF on blue across eu to stop heavy model load. tldr; toggle feature flag now.
ops-bot: @jamie executed: feature-flags set fast-embed=false --env=blue --region=eu-west
jamie: Feature flag toggle acknowledged across control plane, but DNS weight still 25%. Need immediate rollback or adjust routing.
leo: Recommend rolling blue back to previous image (safe) while we drain traffic. Command: `rdeploy rollback --service infer-eu-blue --to v2026-03-10 --force`
sara: Running rollback now. ETA ~2m. Monitoring errors and 5xx rate.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: rollback started (deploy-id: rb-3765432100). Health checks triggered.
maria: 5xx rate dropping from 15% -> 2% over last 90s. Edge-level logs show cache misses decreasing.
kenji: DNS weight still sticky for some POPs — likely stale route table at edge-3. Working on issuing immediate reweight: `routectl set-weight eu-west blue 0.05`
jamie: Good. After rollback and flag off, confirm customer impact: support reported ~12 p95 failures in last 15m for EU customers. No data exfil/product-impact, just transient 502s.
leo: Triage note: rollback + feature flag -> mitigated. We should schedule postmortem + action item to instrument rollout weight gating and monitoring. Assigning owners: postmortem->maria, infra-rework->leo.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated. severity: sev2 -> downgraded. Handoff to oncall-secondary at 3765432400. @kenji take over for cleanup and RCA.
kenji: Taking handoff. I'll keep watch for 30m and then escalate if rate climbs back up.
jamie: Thanks team. I'll fill the incident doc and link to this thread: https://redwood/incidents/3765432100
maria: Adding follow-ups: 1) add preflight check for feature flags on blue during canary flips, 2) shorten DNS TTL for rollout windows, 3) circuit-breaker for model load. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Postmortem template created: https://redwood/pm/3765432100
